rationale.campaign_length: Y86有61项直接任务，Y00另有124项关联任务，阶段继承且不可直接加总。
rationale.colonization: 任务触及环礁岛殖民，但整场战役主轴仍是既有东洲诸国的整合。
rationale.complexity: 代表度、文化组、共和传统、建设门槛、强邻和长线任务须并行处理。
rationale.dark_story: 征服、精灵主导与历史不信任带来争议，但主线不是恐怖或毁灭叙事。
rationale.difficulty: 小国开局与复杂形成门槛抬高难度，帝国成形后实力上升。
rationale.diplomacy: 初期地方领主与友邦关系、后期多族代表和附属安排都要求政治协调。
rationale.early_pressure: 1444小乡邦需在更强势力之间争取生存与最初统一窗口。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 当前任务辨识度集中在代表制度、军制与统一，魔法或奇械并非主轴。
rationale.narrative_density: 希德里翁的身世、诸乡邦人物、议会理想、帝国成立及继承分支形成连续故事。
rationale.tall_play: 城塞、新首都、港口与交通建设重要，但服务于跨区域扩张。
rationale.trade_economy: 工业、港口、瓷器和交通网络明显存在，但不是唯一主机制。
rationale.warfare: 从乡邦统一延伸到东洲多地区军事与政治统合，持续需要战争。

identity.appearance: 1444年四盖乡邦共和国，由日升精灵希德里翁·多兰祖伊尔统治

successors.relationship: 完成Y86专属任务并触发azkare.42后形成，保留出身任务并接续帝国阶段

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text:
精灵希德里翁出生在一个默默无闻的农民家庭，他的姓氏来自于多兰·武絮功领主。多兰注意到希德里翁的才华，并且非正式地收养了他。两代人以来，他一直是阿兹卡雷领主的重要顾问和仆人，因为他对小镇的忠诚服务而被授予爵位。

一个农民崛起成为这片土地上最有权力的人，对阿兹卡雷的广大民众来说是一种激励，他们孜孜不倦地工作，希望能重现他的崛起之路。
description.text_en:
The elf Hiderion was born an unknown peasant, his family name coming from Lord Tonan Prakuong, who took notice of his talents and informally adopted him. For two human generations he served as a valued advisor and retainer of the Azkare lords, being granted lordship for his loyal service to the township.

For a peasant to rise to become the most powerful man in the land serves as an inspiration to the masses of Azkare, who work tirelessly in hopes of replicating his meteoric rise to power.

description.text: 在阿兹卡雷的中心是黎明城堡，这是凤凰帝国建造的一座堡垒，当它穿过该地区时，可以俯瞰上第礼卖的贸易路线。这座城市是围绕着这个堡垒而建的，它一直是我们领主的宫殿，高耸的城墙仍然保护着阿兹卡雷，并在它的外围建立了繁荣的市场。
description.text_en: At the center of Azkare is the Citadel of the Dawn, a fortress built by the Phoenix Empire to overlook the trade routes of the upper Telebei as it passes through the area. The city was built around this bastion, which has been maintained as the palace of our lords, its soaring walls still protecting Azkare and allowing a thriving market to be established just outside of it.

description.text: 羽丝是一种只有在阿兹卡雷才有的独特织物，由技艺精湛的工匠使用一种代代相传的艺术编织而成。它的柔软和轻盈使它在盖邦和其他地方成为一种非常珍贵的商品。
description.text_en: Khanvuphaim is a unique fabric only found in Azkare, woven from feathers by master artisans using an art that has been passed down for generations. Its softness and weightlessness make it a highly prized commodity in Thidinkai and beyond.

description.text: 阿兹卡雷要塞的太阳精灵使用的骑兵风格与这片土地上的普通骑兵截然不同，他们给战马披上厚重的盔甲，手持长枪。凤凰帝国的骑兵以阿兹卡雷的闪光枪骑兵的形式在东洲生存下来，他们全副武装，身着羽丝服装，是我们的精英骑兵部队。
description.text_en: The sun elves that manned the citadel of Azkare utilized a style of cavalry far different from the usual in these lands, cladding their steeds in thick armor and wielding long steel lances. The horsemen of the Phoenix Empire survive in Haless in the form of the Shining Lancers of Azkare, fully armored and decorated with Khanvuphaim garments, acting as our elite cavalry units.

description.text: 由于我们毗邻仙界，我们的城市收纳了大量自这片神秘之地来到的流亡者。他们定居于阿兹卡雷的武术学院「那克里班」，以向我国子民传授武技谋生，极大地提高了我军的作战素质。
description.text_en: Being on the border of the Xianjie, we receive many exiles from the mysterious land to our city. They reside in the Nakhriban, and earn a living by teaching our people their arts, greatly improving the quality of our armed forces.

description.text:
随着「那克里班」的成长，越来越多的人开始修习曾经对外保密的武术。最热心和最熟练的学生都是我们城市的精灵，他们用漫长的生命发展出了一所全新的武艺学派——凤冠流，让我们军队的每一个成员学习。

将仙界武僧的武艺与精灵的纪律相结合，我们勇敢的士兵已经成为一股不可忽视的力量，他们的举止毫不动摇，攻击毫不留情。
description.text_en:
As the Nakhriban grows, more and more of our people learn their formerly secret arts. The most ardent and adept students are found amongst the elves of the city, who have used their long lives to develop an entirely new school, the School of the Phoenix, to be taught to every member of our armies.

By combining the martial prowess of the Xianjie monks with the discipline of the elves, our brave soldiers have become a force to be reckoned with, unwavering in their demeanor and relentless in their assault.

description.text:
散落在东洲大地上的那些精灵是凤凰帝国大崩溃后留下的。他们因复仇而被追杀，大多数人不信任他们，他们只能勉强度日，在肮脏的环境中生活了几个世纪，直到他们最终离开这个世界。对大多数人来说，这似乎是对这片土地上的入侵者和压迫者的适当惩罚，尽管其他人看到了救赎的道路。伟大的希德里翁领主统治他的人类臣民，不是作为一个暴君，而是作为他们正义的守护者、人民的真正仆人和杰雷尔所树立的理想的典范。

为了让东洲的精灵们在这片土地上茁壮成长，他们必须和那些几千年来把这片土地称为家园的精灵们一样，在一个宁静的帝国下和谐团结，建立在希德里翁赖以生存的美德之上。我们不能以征服者或「救世主」的身份统治东洲。我们必须作为她的守护者，和平的守护者，对抗那些企图剥削她的人的哨兵。
description.text_en:
Scattered throughout the lands of Haless lie those elves left behind by the cataclysmic fall of the Phoenix Empire. Hunted out of vengeance and distrusted by most, they scrape by as best they can, living in squalor for centuries until they finally pass from this world. For most this seems a fitting punishment for the invaders and oppressors of this land, though others see a path for redemption. The great lord Hiderion ruled over his human subjects not as a tyrant but as their righteous guardian, a true servant of the people and a paragon of the ideals set by Jaerel.

For the elves of Haless to thrive in this land, they must do so as equals of those that have called this land home for millennia, united in harmony under an serene empire, built on the virtues Hiderion lived by. We must not rule Haless as conquerors, nor as her "saviors". We must rule as her guardians, protectors of the peace and sentinels against those that would seek to exploit her.

description.text:
虽然诃利秣成功征服了罗祆罗阇和烟州，但他和他的后代从来没有想过征服其余的东洲。然而，贾赫没有这些限制。到1127年贾赫去世时，凤凰帝国的疆域从布勒瓦尔延伸到天楼，再到鸦老克林，甚至那些坚如磐石的四盖王国也以和平伙伴的身份加入帝国。

随着凤凰帝国在东洲的复兴，东洲被再次统一在一个单一的仁慈的实体下。
description.text_en:
While Harimar managed to conquer the Rahenraj and Yanshen, he and his descendants never had the means nor desire to conquer the rest of Haless proper. Jaher, however, did not have those limitations. By the time of Jaher's death in 1127, the Phoenix Empire stretched from Bulwar to Tianlou to Arawkelin, and even the stalwart kingdoms of the Sikai were in talks of joining the empire as a peaceful partner.

With the resurgence of the Phoenix Empire in Haless, it is by right that Haless be united under a single benevolent entity once again.

description.text: 意思是「贵族义务」，这个短语来源于太阳精灵作为仁慈和公正的土地统治者的态度。因为他们有统治和保护的责任，太阳精灵的人们必须承担更高的责任和期望。他们必须是世界上好的力量，善良和慷慨，甚至对那些违抗你的人也要有耐心，最终，成为苏雷尔在世界上的化身。
description.text_en: Meaning 'noblesse oblige' or 'nobility obliges', this phrase hearkens back to the sun elven attitudes as benevolent and impartial rulers of the land. Because of their duty to rule and to protect, the sun elven people must be held to higher accountabilities and expectations. They must be a good force in the world; kind and generous, patient with even those that disobey, and ultimately, be the embodiment of Surael in the world.

description.text:
由化道僧侣和四盖武士组成的精英队伍组成的杰雷尔军团成为了现代版的贾赫凤凰军团，但有一个核心区别：他们接受并大量使用非精灵。虽然贾达尔军团的人也采用了这种风格，但日升帝国的军团专注于东洲人的集体价值观，并将化道的仪式姿态融入到他们的操练技术中，使他们成为战场上的强劲对手。

他们最著名的技术是「灼龙之道」，其本质上是一种行进开火的战术，以令人难以置信的速度执行，便能允许整个军团在进入混战之前，立刻向敌人无间断地倾泻火力。
description.text_en:
Formed by an elite cadre of Transmutative Path monks and Sikai warriors, the Jaerelic Legions became the modern version of Jaher's Phoenix Legions with one core difference: they accepted and heavily utilized non-elves. While this style was also adopted by the Jaddari, the legions of the Sunrise Empire focused on the collective values of the Halessi peoples and incorporated the ritualistic gestures of the Transmutative Path in their drilling techniques, making them a fierce opponent in the field.

Their most famous technique was the 'Burning Dragon Technique', which was essentially a fire-and-advance tactic done at an incredibly fast pace, allowing an entire regiment to continuously fire on the enemy immediately prior to entering into melee range.

description.text:
与他一心想征服的父亲和他想要精灵霸权的妹妹不同，杰雷尔梦想一个世界统一——不论种族、信仰或信念，其中可以证明的一点是在他一生挚爱，虎人公主多多嘉，他的正妻。不幸的是，杰雷尔的立场只是被视为没有选择立场，他的许多盟友都抛弃了他。

然而时代变了，世界由安本纳尔的后裔所领导，安本纳尔是一个带来和平和平等的国度，也许东洲现在准备看到旭日之下人人平等。
description.text_en:
Unlike his father, who dreamed only of conquest, and his sister, who dreamed of elven supremacy, Jaerel dreamed of a world united as one - regardless of race, creed or belief, which he espoused to a point in making the love of his life, the harimari princess Tataka, his primary wife. Unfortunately, Jaerel's stance was only seen as a failure to choose a side, which saw many of his allies abandon him.

Times have changed, however, and as the world is led by the scions of Anbennar, a realm created to bring peace and equality, perhaps Haless is now ready to see that All Are Equals Beneath the Rising Sun.

description.text:
雷赞济姆哈尔，即太阳联盟。由学者在19世纪发现和翻译的杰雷尔之意志的遗失部分，雷赞济姆哈尔基本上是一个计划，统一东洲不同文化和宗教，给予他们大量的自治权和特权，以换取由一个公正的太阳精灵宫廷控制的联邦。一切都在公正的太阳精灵中央法庭之下。它被认为是受到了杰雷尔帝国建设努力失败的启发，他有望在被暗杀前不久在娑梨孙伽提出这个建议。

现在，「日升帝国」再次闪耀光芒，或许杰雷尔的野心现在可以实现了。
description.text_en:
Rezan Zimhar. The Alliance of the Sun. Found and translated by scholars in the 19th century from a lost part of Jaerel's will, the Rezan Zimhar was a plan to essentially federalize the disparate and diverse cultures and religions of Haless into a united state which granted them great amounts of autonomy and privileges, all under an impartial sun elven central court. Assumed to be greatly inspired by events surrounding the collapse of Jaerel's empire-building efforts, he had hoped to present this proposal at Sarisung shortly before he was assassinated.

Now that the Sunrise Empire shines ones again, perhaps Jaerel's ambition can now be realized.

description.text:
太阳精灵带来了奥术魔法，这是一种通过学习而掌握的魔法。在此之前，东洲的大多数魔法使用者要么是使用气（他们的精神能量），要么是在东洲社会边缘学习奥术、德鲁伊教和其他魔法的被驱逐者。

织掌派僧侣是一群太阳精灵法师，高等哲学大师和化道僧侣，他们显然花了一百个日夜在天楼上庙辩论精神和魔法的性质。

他们提出的是一种被称为「编织」的魔法概念，人们必须在精神基础上与之联系才能掌握，而不仅仅是通过学习。虽然「编织」的概念从来没有流行，但织掌派僧侣被证明在战斗中是极其致命的，通过类似于太极和耕作实践的法术动作和手势施放奥术咒语，利用其体内的能量，在空中「编织」奥术，而不是用试剂和组件施法。
description.text_en:
The sun elves brought with them arcane magic, a form of magic that was mastered through study and learning. Before that, most magic-users in Haless either utilized chi (their spiritual energy) or were outcasts studying rough forms of arcane, druidic, or other magics in the fringes of Halessi society.

The Monks of the Weaving Palm were a collection of sun elven magi, high philosophers and Transmutative Path monks who apparently spent a hundred days and nights debating on the nature of spirits and magic in the High Temple of Tianlou.

There, they developed a concept of magic that was described as 'the weave', something that one must connect with on a spiritual basis to master, not just through study. While the concept of 'the weave' never reached wide-spread popularity, the Monks of the Weaving Palm proved incredibly deadly in battle, evoking arcane spells through movements and gestures akin to chi and cultivation practices, using nothing but their internal energies - the arcane 'weave' in the air - rather than spell reagents and components.

description.text: 「同舟共济」是日升帝国的一句常用语，可能源于古代烟州的谚语。在奇械术时代的工业化进程中，许多工厂在奇械术士和大亨的资助下在东洲各地建立起来。据说，日升帝国的统一见证了每一个男人、女人和孩子，不论种族，都在提升帝国的过程中发挥着作用——或者在工厂的情况下，就像一个人在流水线上工作一样。
description.text_en: A common saying within the Sunrise Empire, possibly originating from ancient Yan proverbs, "We All Lift Together" was a slogan used during the industrialization initiatives of the Age of Artificery when many factories, funded by artificers and magnates, were created across Haless. It is said that the unity of the Sunrise Empire saw that every man, woman and child, regardless of race, had a role in lifting up the empire - or in a factory's case, worked as one in an assembly line.

player_overview.avoid_if: 只想快速吞地、讨厌代表度与建设前置，或不愿处理强邻压力和漫长任务链的玩家。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 先在盖邦稳住小国、团结乡邦并建立议会，随后同步推进征服、文化代表、新首都和港口建设；形成日升帝国后经营更大规模的东洲统合。
player_overview.overview: 你是1444年东洲盖邦的小城邦阿兹卡雷，领主希德里翁出身精灵农民。开局要在强邻之间团结乡邦、活下来；随后每征服和接纳一片地区，都要解决不同文化怎样在议会中得到代表的问题。准备好首都、港口和政治制度后，你可以成立日升帝国，把理想主义的多族共治推向整个东洲。但精灵仲裁者和大陆征服之间的矛盾，也会始终跟着你。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢弱国长线叙事、议会和文化管理、复杂帝国建设及带争议的理想主义路线的玩家。
signature_features: 文化代表度与议会席位直接成为任务和帝国形成的门槛，不是单纯的背景设定。
希德里翁从农民到领主的经历，串起乡邦联合、个人合法性与多族共治理想。
Y86专属事件形成Y00并延续任务；另有希德里翁身故后的四盖继承改道。
player_overview.tagline: 从一座精灵领主统治的乡邦出发，让东洲各族在同一个议会中拥有席位。

reasons: 议会代表制度与征服统一直接耦合
希德里翁个人故事和日升理想贯穿长线
形成帝国后仍有连续任务与多族军制
warnings: 小国开局与周边强邻压力高
代表度和建设门槛会限制纯军事推进
帝国理想与精灵主导并非毫无矛盾

positive_indicators: 文化代表度进入议会与任务条件
农民出身者可获得政治晋升
新首都、道路与港口等公共建设
values.rationale: 面向多族群的代表制度、反贵族出身垄断及公共交通建设有明确正向目标；但精灵仲裁地位、对部分外来文化宗教的边界与征服式统一使克制较低。评分不因帝国化、精灵身份或扩张本身加减分，未把Wiki的理论帝国当作历史已实现。
red_flags: 以战争推进跨地区政治统一
精灵仲裁者与平等代表存在权力不对称
理想国对部分外来文化宗教并非无条件开放
